name: Reference 21
definition: Reference to the collateral management transaction (exposure) or the contract identification of  the sender (collateral taker) or the receiver (triparty agent)

SenderCollateralTransactionIdentificatio.name: Sender Collateral Transaction Identification
SenderCollateralTransactionIdentificatio.definition: Unique reference identifying the collateral management transaction (exposure) from the collateral taker's or the collateral giver point of view.

ReceiverCollateralTransactionIdentificat.name: Receiver Collateral Transaction Identification
ReceiverCollateralTransactionIdentificat.definition: Unique reference identifying the collateral management transaction (exposure)  from the triparty agent's point of view.

SenderCollateralContractIdentification.name: Sender Collateral Contract Identification
SenderCollateralContractIdentification.definition: Unique reference identifying the collateral management contract from the collateral taker's or the collateral giver's point of view.

ReceiverCollateralContractIdentification.name: Receiver Collateral Contract Identification
ReceiverCollateralContractIdentification.definition: Unique reference identifying the collateral management contract from the triparty agent's point of view.

CommonTransactionIdentification.name: Common Transaction Identification
CommonTransactionIdentification.definition: Unique identification (UTI) agreed upon by the two trade counterparties to identify the transaction/exposure or the contract.

SenderCollateralTransactionIdentificatio.definition: If  Sender Collateral Transaction Identification is absent then Receiver Collateral Transaction Identification  or Sender Collateral Contract Identification or  Receiver Collateral Contract Identification or Common Transaction Identification must be present.

ReceiverCollateralTransactionIdentificat.definition: If Receiver Collateral Transaction Identification is absent then Sender Collateral Transaction Identification or Sender Collateral Contract Identification or Receiver Collateral Contract Identification or Common Transaction Identification must be present.

SenderCollateralContractIdentificationPr.definition: If Sender Collateral Contract Identification is absent then Sender Collateral Transaction Identification or Receiver Collateral Transaction Identification or Receiver Collateral Contract Identification or Common Transaction Identification must be present.

ReceiverCollateralContractIdentification.definition: If Receiver Collateral Contract Identification is absent then Sender Collateral Transaction Identification or Receiver Collateral Transaction Identification or Sender Collateral Contract Identification or Common Transaction Identification must be present.

CommonTransactionIdentificationPresenceR.definition: If Common Transaction Identification is absent then Sender Collateral Transaction Identification or Receiver Collateral Transaction Identification or Sender Collateral Contract Identification or Receiver Collateral Contract Identification  must be present.
